**Language:** <!-- e.g. Français (fr) -->

Attach your `<code>.txt` (a translated copy of `lang/en.txt`) or open a pull request that adds it to the `lang/` folder.
Tip: test it first by putting the file into `BepInEx\plugins\ShopBot\lang\` – it shows up in the dashboard language picker right away.
